gloss: to pick up and collect; to gather up

definitions.gloss: to pick up and collect; to gather up
definitions.explanation: To pick up scattered things one by one and gather them together; also used of collecting scattered information or opinions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: I gathered up the fallen leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散|ち}らばった→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: I pick up the scattered papers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{集|あつ}める⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I took part in a volunteer cleanup picking up litter on the beach.

notes:
⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧ (to pick up) + ⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (to collect).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{集|あつ}める: to pick up litter
- ⟦{破片|はへん}→破片：00082_hahen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{集|あつ}める: to gather up the pieces
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{集|あつ}める: to piece together information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める→掻き集める：06238_kakiatsumeru⟧: to scrape together; suggests haste or difficulty in finding enough
